root.ko: 사막 한가운데서 밤을 낮처럼 밝히는 쇼와 빛의 도시 — 1950~60년대 스트립의 모든 호텔에 쇼걸이 있었고 경쟁으로 쇼와 의상이 점점 화려해졌으며(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Showgirl), 8.5에이커 인공 호수의 분수는 음악에 맞춰 140미터까지 솟고(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fountains_of_Bellagio), 20세기 중반 전성기의 옛 간판 200개 넘게가 간판 마당에 모여 밤에 다시 빛난다(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neon_Museum) → 빛의 왕도 레뷰 극장의 깃털 여왕(판타지) · 분수 밸브 오르간 연주자(스팀펑크) · 두 세기 뒤 옛 간판 복원가(사이버펑크). 2026-11-27 시안 — 시험 그림 전

fantasy.job_ko: 빛의 왕도 레뷰 극장의 깃털 여왕
fantasy.place: the vast gilded stage of the grand revue theatre of her world's desert capital of light at the height of the night's show — a towering staircase of glowing steps behind her, plumed dancers fanning out on either side, crystal lamps blazing in the gilded proscenium and coloured light pouring down over the stage
fantasy.activity: she is the revue queen who leads the finale, descending the staircase of light toward the footlights with slow, sure steps, holding her great feather plume out to one side as the gilded feather wings sway at her back
fantasy.prop: a single enormous sweeping plume of rose-pink and gold feathers, its quill bound in gilt and its tip glittering with crystal drops

outfit.bold: a revue-queen look fitted to her body — a high-cut gilded bodysuit glittering with thousands of crystals, sheer sparkling tights, a towering headdress of rose-pink and gold plumes strung with tiny glowing coloured lamps, a sweeping backpiece of gilded feather wings and gold strappy heels
outfit.moderate: a revue-queen look — a gilded crystal-studded corset bodice over a short flared skirt of layered gold fringe, sheer sparkling tights, a towering headdress of rose-pink and gold plumes strung with tiny glowing coloured lamps, a backpiece of gilded feather wings and gold heels
outfit.low: a revue-queen look — a long-sleeved high-necked gown of gold crystal-beaded silk sweeping to the floor, a towering headdress of rose-pink and gold plumes strung with tiny glowing coloured lamps and a backpiece of gilded feather wings

steampunk.place: a terrace above the great lake of her gaslamp desert city at dusk — the brass console of a towering valve organ, its keys and stops linked by gleaming pipes to the fountains below, jets of water leaping in time over the lake, clean white steam curling from the valves and the bulb-lit marquees of the boulevard glowing on the far shore
steampunk.activity: she is the fountain organist, leaning over the brass console and pressing the stops with both gloved hands as the jets on the lake leap to her music, a loop of punched paper music unrolling across the keys
steampunk.prop: a long brass-capped roll of punched paper music unrolling across the organ keys

outfit.bold: a fountain-diva look fitted to her body — an off-shoulder silver-blue silk gown with a low neckline and brass boning rising like organ pipes, its long skirt slit high to the thigh and tiered at the hem like leaping fountain jets beaded with crystal droplets, lavender lace opera gloves above the elbow, a tall feathered headdress on a brass fountain crest and brass-buckled heels
outfit.moderate: a fountain-diva look — an off-shoulder silver-blue silk gown with brass boning rising like organ pipes, a floor-length skirt with a knee-high slit tiered at the hem like leaping fountain jets and beaded with crystal droplets, lavender lace opera gloves above the elbow and a tall feathered headdress on a brass fountain crest
outfit.low: a fountain-diva look — a silver-blue silk gown with a high lace neckline and long lace sleeves, brass boning rising like organ pipes, a floor-length skirt tiered at the hem like fountain jets, lavender lace opera gloves and a tall feathered headdress on a brass fountain crest

cyberpunk.job_ko: 두 세기 뒤 옛 간판 마당의 간판 복원가
cyberpunk.place: the old sign yard of her far-future city beneath its transparent dome at night — towering mid-century signs of starbursts, arrows and giant shells all around, some still dark and some relit tube by tube in pink, cyan and gold, with no letters on any of them
cyberpunk.activity: she is the sign restorer, standing on the gravel among the giant signs and lifting a freshly relit glass tube up against the dark sky to check its glow, an amused look in her eyes
cyberpunk.prop: a short salvaged sign tube bent into a starburst, glowing pink and cyan, held up beside her slender glass restoration wand

outfit.bold: a sign-restorer look fitted to her body — a cropped pale chrome jacket studded along every edge with tiny warm marquee bulbs worn open over a fitted bandeau top, crossing harness straps traced with thin glowing pink and cyan tubes, high-cut fitted shorts, starburst earrings of salvaged sign glass and tall boots
outfit.moderate: a sign-restorer look — a cropped pale chrome jacket studded along every edge with tiny warm marquee bulbs over a fitted crop top, crossing harness straps traced with thin glowing pink and cyan tubes, fitted short shorts over sheer tights, starburst earrings and tall boots
outfit.low: a sign-restorer look — a long-sleeved high-collared pale chrome jacket studded along every edge with tiny warm marquee bulbs zipped over a fitted top, harness straps traced with thin glowing pink and cyan tubes, slim fitted work trousers, starburst earrings and tall boots
